I been farming this 15 mu for 40 years. My boy moved to the city, so it's just me and the wife working the land. I do wheat and maize on the same ground — that's 10 mu in the rotation. The other 5 mu I keep in cotton because the dealer in town still buys it and the soil there is a bit lighter, not so good for grain.

Let me think through each one.

**Wheat (10 mu, winter).** I plant after I take the maize off in October. I use improved seed from the agri-supply shop — the same kind my neighbor Old Wang uses, he gets good crop every year. I spread compound fertilizer before sowing, about 2 bags per mu (that's 50 kg bags, 15-15-15, so roughly 7-8 kg of each N, P, K). Then in spring when it starts jointing I top-dress urea, about 20 kg per mu — that gives me the nitrogen it needs. So total N comes out about 22 kg, P about 8 kg, K about 7 kg per mu. I water 4 times — before winter, at jointing, at heading, and grain filling. Well water is fine, I have the pump. I spray 2 times for aphids and rust. Rotary after maize, no deep plough — saves time and diesel. I expect about 480 kg per mu, that's what I usually get.

**Maize (10 mu, summer).** Straight after wheat harvest in June. No-till, I just drill the seed right in the wheat stubble — everyone does it now, saves a round of tractor work. Hybrid seed, I won't risk open-pollinated, yield is too much lower. I put compound fertilizer with the seed drill, about 1.5 bags per mu, then top-dress urea at the big-trumpet stage, 15 kg. Total N maybe 22 kg, P 7, K 6. I irrigate once if July is dry, maybe twice if no rain. Spray once for corn borer, sometimes twice. I get around 550 kg per mu when the weather is right.

**Cotton (5 mu, spring).** I plough this ground in March — cotton wants loose soil. Use hybrid seed, Bt kind so the bollworm don't eat me alive. Put base fertilizer 2 bags compound per mu, then side-dress urea twice, 10 kg each time. Total N about 20 kg, P 8, K 8 — cotton likes potash, I don't skimp there. Irrigate 3 times. Cotton needs many sprays, I do 6 times through the season for aphids, spider mite, and bollworm even with Bt. I get maybe 240 kg seed cotton per mu. Not a lot of money in it anymore but the ground is set up for it and I'm too old to change everything.
